findings.message: EOL date 2027-04-16 exceeds the 3-month cap for upstream-sourced rocks without an accepted support plan. The demo rock sources from canonical/demo-rock (source-type: git), making it upstream-sourced. Per §2 release policy, end-of-life must not exceed today (2026-10-16) + 3 months. Proposed EOL is approximately 6 months away. Either provide a support plan accepted in CODEOWNERS or amend the EOL to no later than 2027-01-16.

summary: Patch-version bump from v1.2.0 to v1.2.1 with no recipe regression; deb-security-manifest present. EOL extension violates 3-month cap for upstream-sourced rock without support plan.
